Clear messages for 404, private repo, rate limit (403/429 with reset time). No token support yet (PRD 17.6). Feeds the validator. Records source {type:'github', owner, repo, ref, path, commit sha}.

tasks.details: src/features/course-import/zip.ts with fflate: check type/size (≤ 20 MB) before reading, iterate entries without extracting to disk (in-memory map), reject absolute paths, '..' segments, backslashes, drive letters, symlink entries, too many files (≤ 500), too-large uncompressed total (zip bomb guard, ≤ 50 MB), disallowed extensions; strip a single top-level folder. Feeds the validator.
tasks.testStrategy: Vitest with generated fixtures: valid zip → course; traversal, absolute path, zip bomb, too many files, bad extension each rejected

tasks.title: Content Security Policy, security headers and security review
tasks.description: Ship with CSP and a completed security review (PRD 17.2, 22.3).
tasks.details:
Define CSP (default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; worker-src 'self' blob:; img-src 'self' blob: data: https:; connect-src 'self' https://api.github.com https://raw.githubusercontent.com; frame-src 'self' blob:/srcdoc as needed) in the host's config (vercel.json headers or the server config) and a meta fallback for dev. Run the `security-review` skill; fix or file its findings. Document in SECURITY.md.

[2026-11-15T18:07:41-05:00] note from 10: index.html has an inline theme script that CSP script-src 'self' will block; allow via sha256 hash or move to public/theme-init.js
